formVectors.name: Talon Vector
formVectors.summary: Raptorial skeletal scaffold: hooked digits, hollow-bone bias, striking posture.
formVectors.skeletalScaffold: hooked distal phalanges; light, load-bearing forelimbs; cranial narrowing toward a striking line
formVectors.tissueStress: nail beds, distal joints, and the small bones of the wrist
formVectors.notes: Named example from the terminology lexicon. Full physiology is undetermined.

formVectors.name: Barrow Vector
formVectors.summary: Subterranean scaffold: heavy-set, load-bearing, built to go into earth rather than over it.
formVectors.skeletalScaffold: shortened limbs; reinforced shoulder girdle; skull thickened against collapse
formVectors.tissueStress: shoulders, spine, and the finger bones that become spades
formVectors.notes: Named example from the terminology lexicon.

formVectors.name: Ridge Vector
formVectors.summary: Plated, weight-bearing spinal shelf; a braced stance rather than a strike or a burrow.
formVectors.skeletalScaffold: dorsal osteoderms; locked lumbar stack; wide stance
formVectors.tissueStress: scapulae, lumbar fascia, and the skin over the new ridge
formVectors.notes: Extra illustrative example — not attested in the lexicon.

affinityCadences.name: Ember Cadence
affinityCadences.summary: Heat and combustion as temperament: short fuse, bright work, a crash after.
affinityCadences.thermalProfile: violent thermal overshoot, then a hard crash into hypothermia
affinityCadences.notes: Named example from the terminology lexicon.

affinityCadences.name: Marsh Cadence
affinityCadences.summary: Wet weight and anaerobic drag. The body becomes heavier than the water it wants.
affinityCadences.thermalProfile: low smolder during the Shift; long wet chill in the aftermath
affinityCadences.notes: Named example from the terminology lexicon.

affinityCadences.name: Gale Cadence
affinityCadences.summary: Pressure and thin air. Restless temperament; heat leaves the body too fast.
affinityCadences.thermalProfile: little fever; shaking cold arrives while the Shift is still running
affinityCadences.notes: Extra illustrative example — not attested in the lexicon.

mutatorNodes.name: Gross Node
mutatorNodes.summary: Scales mass. More body to feed, more body to tear, more body to warm afterward.
mutatorNodes.effect: mass scale — bulk without changing the Form's grammar
mutatorNodes.notes: Named example from the terminology lexicon (mass).

mutatorNodes.name: Feral Node
mutatorNodes.summary: Instinct-dominance. The Shift thinks faster than the name; predatory affect arrives early.
mutatorNodes.effect: instinct-dominance — Drift comes forward in the order of operations
mutatorNodes.notes: Named example from the terminology lexicon (instinct-dominance).

mutatorNodes.name: Hollow Node
mutatorNodes.summary: Reduces density. Less mass, worse cold, a thinner hold on the name afterward.
mutatorNodes.effect: density drop — identity thins with the bones
mutatorNodes.notes: Extra illustrative example — not attested in the lexicon.
